title: AgentOS Verification Kernel: Prototype Lineage v0.1.1-v0.5.0
description: Frozen software lineage archive for the AgentOS Verification Kernel research prototype, preserving releases v0.1.1 through v0.5.0 with fresh Linux verification logs, release hashes, freeze metadata, and an expanded copy of the latest source. Research prototype only; not production security software.
notes: No license is asserted because the supplied releases contain no license file. The original v0.5.0 ZIP is preserved unchanged; its internal SHA256SUMS.txt contains a self-checksum entry that fails while all other entries pass.
